Amelia: @sanjay quick heads up — I see your USCIS biometrics appointment is on 2024-12-02 and your remote onboarding is slated for 2024-12-03. Can you reschedule or do you need guidance for remote I-9 verification?
Sanjay: Ugh, I can try to reschedule but earliest open slot I see is 2024-12-10. Will that block my start? Also unsure how benefits effective date works if start moves.
Amelia: We can be flexible. Two paths: 1) If you reschedule earlier, we keep original start. 2) If not, you can start remotely but must complete physical ID verification within 3 business days via our vendor (or come onsite). Benefits typically kick the 1st of the next month after your start. Ping me if you need an exception.
Sanjay: If I start remotely and verification is after start, do I need to pause any access until verification completes?
Amelia: No automatic pause — we do role-based access and can provision basic laptop + account. Full production access usually gated until docs cleared. We'll coordinate with IT.
Lisa: For immigration side — USCIS ASC appointments have lots of churn. Try the "transfer" option in my.uscis.gov or check walk-in cancellations. If you have an EAD or H-1 receipt notice, send a scanned copy to secure-hr@redwood.com so we can keep your file up to date.
Sanjay: Ok I'll try transfer now. If I can't get earlier, can your vendor come to me in NYC? I'm downtown Manhattan.
Amelia: Yes — we use a NYC verification partner. I can schedule them for within 48 hours of a requested date. Where are you roughly (borough/zip)?
Sanjay: Manhattan, 10013.
Amelia: Perfect. I'll request the vendor. @Derek FYI on laptop provisioning and hold shipping until start confirmed.
Derek: Got it — we'll build the laptop on 2024-11-29 and hold shipping. If start is confirmed, we ship overnight. If you need the device earlier for testing, tell us and we can arrange local pickup in NYC.
hr-bot: Reminder: please upload passport + I-94 or EAD receipt to secure-hr@redwood.com or the 1Password shared folder before verification.
Sanjay: Update — I was able to reschedule to 2024-12-05 10:00am at the ASC. Sending passport scan and receipt notice now to secure-hr. Thanks for the help!
Amelia: Awesome, thanks for the quick update. I'll mark onboarding checklist accordingly and confirm benefits effective date (should be 2025-01-01 given 2024-12-03 vs 2024-12-05 no change, but will confirm with benefits ops). :thumbsup:
Lisa: Reminder — bring originals to the ASC verification. If your EAD is pending, bring both receipt and passport.
Sanjay: Will do. Appreciate everyone.
Amelia: Closing loop — vendor booked tentatively for 2024-12-05 10:00am in case needed, calendar invite sent. If anything changes, DM me.
